scope.statement: Covers what the application and the final report ask for. Selection criteria are on the programme page.

requirements.statement: Show that the tool is used beyond your own team.
requirements.evidence: Any of: download counts, projects that depend on it, or statements from users. Say how you counted.

presentation.instructions: Attach a PDF of up to two pages.

requirements.statement: Send a final report on what the grant paid for and what changed.

timing.statement: Due three months after the grant ends.
